title: Command and clarification cases, Italian and English

Cases over invented sites cover commands (add_door, add_window, split_rooms, add_floor, set_roof, add_structure and others), building names and sides, and clarification (an unclear or impossible request returns no commands and one question, ai-prompt.ts:84)

escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 16 to 20 cases, half Italian. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
